violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the service area is lacking handwashing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Container was observed in the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Per interview of staff, coffee utensils are only washed, rinsed, and sanitized at the end of the day. The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (empanada maker and attachments) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took unit out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Quipe was observed held at 125 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC could have reheated, but decided to discard due to quality reasons. PIC also turned up hot-hold unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Various TCS items were observed held between 57-81 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed of eggs and relocated other items to cooler for active cooling. PIC informed not to store TCS items on top of containers in prep unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Pork was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC wrote name on bottle. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Various food items were observed stored on the floor in the in kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Coffee utensil was observed stored in stagnant water between uses. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Various single service items were observed stored on the floor in the in basement and service area. Single service items must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/22/2026

Dessert display cooler located in the front area was not in good repair (ambient of 55F). Per interview with PIC, establishment plans on using cooler for flan, tres leches, and ect - which require refrigeration of 41F or below. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
Menu lacks an allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
Establishment lacks sanitizer (chlorine) for 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration units. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 05/11/2026

Dessert display cooler located in the front area was not in good repair (ambient of 60F). Per interview with PIC, establishment plans on using cooler for flan, tres leches, and ect - which require refrigeration of 41F or below. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the prep unit have an accumulation old tape/adhesive residue. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
Inspector observed hood vent/lights in poor repair (vent and lights did not turn on). PIC has work order in place. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
